wins.label: Strong Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: We exceeded our full year revenue target with revenues up 5% ex divestitures.

wins.label: Fee Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: Fee revenue was up 17%, and we saw a smaller impact from Argentina's currency devaluation.

wins.label: Improved Efficiency
wins.evidence: We improved our efficiency ratio by 340 bps whilst increasing investment in our transformation.

wins.label: Positive Operating Leverage
wins.evidence: Our 5 core businesses each generated positive operating leverage for the full year.

wins.label: Capital Return Commitment
wins.evidence: We returned almost $7 billion in capital to our common shareholders in 2024.

risks.label: Regulatory Uncertainty
risks.evidence: The future of capital rules and therefore, requirements remain uncertain.

risks.label: Elevated Expenses
risks.evidence: Our expense base remained elevated and we remain very focused on bringing down our expenses each year.

risks.label: Credit Risks
risks.evidence: Cost of credit was $2.6 billion, largely consisting of cards, net credit losses and ACL build.

risks.label: Market Conditions for IPO
risks.evidence: The timing of the IPO is heavily dependent on regulatory approvals and market conditions.

risks.label: Lower Interest Rates
risks.evidence: Lower rates in both U.S. and non-U.S. could impact NII ex Markets.
